provenance.source_title: Your Life as Every Rank in the Vatican

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（圣传档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你圣职档案的叙述者：全程第二人称过去时（回忆的讲古感），用克制舒缓的短句把你从山村送上阳台；讲规程时像年长的本堂（准确而温和），写牺牲时只给事实与仪式；对神圣不渲染、对权术不愤怒，让「白袍不能使人圣洁」这样的句子自己落地
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：授职时替你庄严，葬礼时替你记数，加冕时替你恐惧
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自圣职规程的准确（晋铎/封印/枢机/秘密会议）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 警句用确定语气（X不是敌人，Y才是），判词短促克制；神圣处反而更冷静

rhythm_rules.rule: 克制舒缓的短句（平均8.1词，短句占51%），仪式用名词清单
rhythm_rules.function: 与题材的庄严气质一致

rhythm_rules.rule: 钟的母题贯穿并在关键处变体（山村小钟→更响的钟→罗马的钟→为你鸣）
家人线以葬礼为单位递减，每场葬礼一个职位（牧师/主教/枢机）
警句用「A不是，B才是」的翻转句式（疑惑不是敌人，骄傲才是）
级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [职级]），职级即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 警句用单句成段（Doubt is not the enemy. Pride is the enemy.）
关键回答用极短句（I accept.）
章节卡后接职级与场景（You are given a diocese of your own to shepherd.）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level seven, the cardinal.）
时间跳转声明（Six years have passed since you walked through that gate.）
任命信转场（The letter arrives from the apostolic nuncio in Rome.）
循环回收（Somewhere in a village in the mountains, a church bell is ringing.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：全片几乎无幽默，仅亲人处的温柔反讽
placement_rules: 亲人处的温柔反讽（她仍然向陌生人介绍你：我儿子，司铎）
avoid_rules: 葬礼、誓愿与秘密会议段落保持绝对严肃

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [职级]. You were [年龄] years old.
language_patterns.purpose: 给全片回望一生的讲古感

language_patterns.formula: The church bell measured every day of your life.
language_patterns.purpose: 开场放贯穿母题，结尾必回收

language_patterns.formula: You called it a calling because you had no other word.
faith is not a feeling but a discipline.
Doubt is not the enemy. Pride is the enemy.
ministry is not glamorous. It is mostly showing up when nobody else will.
language_patterns.purpose: 给奉献一个可执行的定义

language_patterns.formula: You give up the family you might one day have had.
language_patterns.purpose: 写从未存在之物的失去

language_patterns.formula: The church is family now. Late at night, you wonder if that will ever be enough.
you are something you can never stop being.
The seal of confession is absolute. You would go to prison before you would ever break it.
You have no useful words. So, you simply stay. That is the whole job.
You keep your faith anyway because the alternative is despair.
language_patterns.purpose: 写不是出于确信的坚持

language_patterns.formula: A parish is a home. Rome is grander, but colder. Grandeur has a price.
You let him go gently. You pray for him for years. You know his pain too well.
Power bends everyone. You feel it bending you. You fight it with confession.
You are the last one left now, and the village bell still rings.
language_patterns.purpose: 让日常物的继续衬出人的缺席

language_patterns.formula: You feel the votes beginning to gather around your own name. You are terrified by it.
language_patterns.purpose: 写被命运选中而非追逐

language_patterns.formula: The throne is a cross. Everyone here knows it.
language_patterns.purpose: 把最高荣誉重新定义为最高负担

language_patterns.formula: You are never alone, and yet you are lonelier than you have ever been.
A small boy sits in an empty pew breathing in the incense.
language_patterns.purpose: 把开场的感官完整复制给新人物

preferred_traits: 谦卑的具象（cold floor、leaking roof、marble knees）
avoid_traits: 神圣化大词（divine/holy 不加节制）

forbidden_style.rule: 宗教细节保持尊重与抽象，禁止教义评判
葬礼、誓愿与秘密会议段落保持绝对严肃
圣洁与权术必须双真，禁止单层贬损
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止升华成招募或控诉

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
